children: unveiled an investment of nearly 200 million yuan ($29.81 million) to upgrade its production and supply base in Wuxi, China, the company's Chinese unit said in a statement on Thursday.

The upgraded facility, which will be used for development and production of AstraZeneca's innovative cardiovascular drugs, is expected to be operational in the last quarter of 2029, the pharmaceutical firm said.
